turns:
Add a burst allowance to src/ratelimit.js: the constructor must accept an options object as third argument, new RateLimiter(limit, windowMs, {burst: n}), permitting at most limit+n requests per window (default burst 0, existing behavior unchanged). Also add a remaining() method returning how many requests are still allowed in the current window.
Scope: src/ratelimit.js only
Acceptance criteria: limit 2 + burst 1 permits exactly 3 requests per window; remaining() reports correctly; every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: node --test tests/*.test.js
Stop when the tests pass.
Develop several distinct approaches to this fix, compare their trade-offs
explicitly, and only then select and implement the best one.
